title: The Jump Derby
logline: When an inter-system betting pool corners gate coolant to fix an endurance jump rally, independent courier pilots fight to keep their engines alive.

roles.description: Oversees the inter-system rally book; smooth, immaculate, and quietly manipulating gate coolant supplies to protect bookmaker margins.
A veteran freight pilot who mortgaged their family ship to enter the cross-system jump rally.
An armed heavy patrol corvette deployed to enforce private coolant monopolies around the midpoint jump gate.
A high-speed corporate transport carrying the syndicate's mobile betting mainframe and audit drives.
The glittering orbital casino station where opening odds and rally route charters are officially posted.
A remote jump gate junction two systems out where overheated rally craft must vent core radiation.
The collective fellowship of independent cargo pilots flying in the cross-sector derby.
The massive inter-system bookmaking conglomerate holding the rally escrow pool.

public_situation: Tens of thousands gather at {system}'s wagering pavilion as the tri-system Jump Derby begins, backing long-haul couriers against corporate teams.
private_truth: The pool director quietly bought up all thorium-doped thermal coolant at the midpoint gate, forcing independent pilots to withdraw from overheating.

beats.public_change: The rally pavilion broadcasts departure green-lights as sixty couriers burn toward the first jump gate.

missions.reason: The navigator hires an outsider to courier their certified navigational flight slate to the registrar before the entry deadline closes.
missions.private_fact: The navigator pawned their life savings to pay the registration fee and faces debtor prison if disqualified.

beats.public_change: Racers arrive at the midpoint gate only to find thermal coolant priced ten times above normal rates.

missions.reason: The navigator asks the pilot to purchase emergency coolant drums from a nearby civilian fuel depot and haul them to the staging berths.
missions.private_fact: Over half the independent fleet has red-lined their jump drives and cannot jump without immediate coolant flushes.

beats.public_change: Syndicate enforcers deploy an armed corvette to impound unmetered coolant canisters at the gate.

missions.reason: The navigator begs the pilot to destroy the private corvette preventing the independent ships from loading the coolant canisters.
missions.private_fact: The corvette captain carries standing orders to scuttle any independent craft attempting an unauthorized jump.

beats.public_change: The syndicate director arrives on an inspection yacht to declare the independent ships disqualified for schedule delay.

missions.reason: The navigator needs the pilot to scan the gate's commercial registry beacon to extract proof of the artificial coolant embargo.
missions.private_fact: The beacon logs prove the director purchased exclusive supply rights through a dummy shell company two weeks before the race.

beats.public_change: The surviving rally ships approach the final system pavilion where crowds await the championship finish.

missions.reason: The navigator asks the pilot to disable the director's escort yacht before it can transmit forged disqualification orders to the judges.
missions.private_fact: The director hails mid-fight, offering a share of the grand betting escrow if the pilot hands over the embargo logs.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the proof of market cornering before the rally arbitration box. The couriers demand justice, while the syndicate offers a private payout.

options.label: Present the embargo logs to crown the independent couriers champions and break the monopoly
Broker a permanent pilot-owned coolant utility cooperative under shared gate oversight
Sell the evidence to the director in exchange for an escrow payout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the embargo logs to the judges.
resolutions.summary: Arbitrators award the grand prize to {role:courier_fraternity}; {role:pool_director} is disgraced while {role:independent_navigator} buys back family ships.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a gambling syndicate tried to boil out independent racers at the midpoint gate.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a cooperative utility pact.
resolutions.summary: {role:courier_fraternity} secures permanent refueling shares at {role:midpoint_gate}, stabilizing long-haul margins against speculative cartels.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the escrow cut or sells the logs.
resolutions.summary: {role:wagering_syndicate} collects on all favored corporate hulls; independent couriers default on debts while {role:pool_director} receives bonuses.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: Overheated independent engines burn out at the gate; {role:wagering_syndicate} forecloses on stranded hulls and sweeps all betting pots.

loose_threads.detail: Spot prices for thorium thermal coolant spiked fortyfold twelve hours before the official derby departure.
Digital seals on the seized coolant containers carried authorization stamps from an off-system transit regulatory commission.

radio_hooks: Tri-system Jump Derby launches from {system} with record betting handle.
Independent couriers lodge formal protest over exorbitant gate refueling charges.
{role:wagering_syndicate} defends gate coolant surge pricing as legitimate free-market logistics.

voice_direction.pool_director: Cultivated, silky, speaking in measured corporate aphorisms and smiling while explaining why contractual clauses are unavoidable.
voice_direction.independent_navigator: Gravelly, fatigued, speaking with fierce stubborn pride and dropping sharp orbital slang between calculations.
